title: Letter to William Shockley recommending L. Ron Hubbard
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Letter to William Shockley recommending L. Ron Hubbard, about 1950s at an unknown place, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And it turns out he's talking about L. Ron Hubbard.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in the 1950s Claude Shannon, the mathematician who founded information theory, wrote a letter to William Shockley, a physicist who helped invent the transistor, recommending someone to him. According to Michels, the person turns out to be L. Ron Hubbard, the founder of Scientology. He tells it to show how close fringe figures were to top scientists of the time.
